limitations: CE9-F1 runtime lowering of signals, drivers and periodic motion remains a reasoned follow-up to preserve legacy float ordering.
Discrete and bezier-path expression/bake targets, 3D values (CE8) and Lab editing (CE11) are outside CE9.
Spring/follow-through integration starts at frame 0; evaluation cost grows with frame number.
Baking requires integer layer times; colours round to 8-bit channels with a warning.
Strict WebGL 0.36 family audits were not rerun. Their outstanding correctness evidence remains separate CE6 work.
WebGL 1.25x family timing and CE6 2x speed targets remain deferred performance (CE6-P); no tuning or resolution claim.
notes: Case-level timing uses the median of three paired passes; assertions and tolerances are unchanged.
A null case minPsnr represents infinite PSNR for identical pixels.
The unrelated concurrent audio-research dev-log entry is preserved in the working tree and excluded from CE9 commits.
